    static final int MODY = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 2000000;
    static final int MAX = 1000000;
    static long total_n;
    static long cnt;
    static int total_cnt;
    static int final_ans;
    static int depth_limit = 6;
    static int[] pw_arr = new int[9];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            data_vec[i] = new ArrayList<>();

    static int mod_diff(int x, int y, int m) {
        return (x - y < 0) ? x - y + m : x - y;
    }

    static int mod_sum(int x, int y, int m) {
        return (x + y >= m) ? x + y - m : x + y;
    }

    static void build(int level, int val) {
        if (val <= total_n) {
            total_cnt++;
            int x = mod_diff(total_cnt, val, MODX);
            data_vec[level - 1].add(x);
            sum_arr[level - 1] = mod_sum(sum_arr[level - 1], x, MODY);

        if (level > 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; ++i) {

    static void process(int level, long current) {
        if (current > total_n) return;

            if (10L * current * MAX > total_n && (1L * (current + 1) * MAX - 1) <= total_n) {
                for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) {

                    final_ans = mod_diff(final_ans, (int) ((1L * MODX * (data_vec[i].size() - p)) % MODY), MODY);

            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
